draft.subject: One quick step to get Timber Ventures moving
draft.body:
Hi Kai,

No reply needed to my earlier notes — I know launch weeks get busy. If it's helpful, the quickest way to see value is getting one real project started: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a 15-minute call this week work? I'm happy to walk through your first project with you and answer anything else.

Best,
Chidi
